text:
ends_with
Description
Tests if one string ends with another string.
Syntax
<
string1
>
ends_with
<
string2
>
<string1> ends_with <string2>
Tests if string1 ends with string2.
Equivalent to the
TCL string match
command
:
string
match
*
string2
string1
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
if
{
[
HTTP
::
uri
]
ends_with
".gif"
}
{
pool
my_pool
}
elseif
{
[
HTTP
::
uri
]
ends_with
".jpg"
}
{
pool
your_pool
}
}
